basis: Manual production caller/render-condition proof plus current TypeScript module resolution, all incoming runtime/type/literal dynamic import edges and repository source string searches. Static unreachability alone was not used as proof.
conditional_invariant: TravellerPortal is the only production caller of UploadFlow.
Both observe the same upload-links/token query key under the same QueryClient provider.
Parent renders legacy child only for error or missing group; child checks that same failure before happy-path stages.
On successful recovery the parent renders current portal/Fresh/returning and unmounts legacy child.
Lean fallback uses primary error/isFetching/refetch directly and never reads/writes private recovery records.
